# One-time: CHI charters the Western Regions Protectorate (real gold + stability cost, trade-off modifier).
oe_ytm_dec_western_protectorate = {
    decision_category = country_specific_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        tag = CHI
        oe_ytm_yuan_ok = yes
        current_date >= 1385.1.1
        OR = {
            has_global_variable = oe_ytm_on
            oe_ytm_completed = yes
        }
        NOT = { var:oe_ytm_dec_prot ?= 1 }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        owns = location:dadu
        gold >= 120
        stability >= 0
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ytm_dec_western_protectorate.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ytm_dec_prot value = 1 }
            add_gold = -120
            add_stability = -5
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_ytm_tarim value = 1 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ytm_protectorate_mod months = 180 mode = replace }
            location:turpan = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ytm_oasis_garrison months = 180 mode = replace } }
            location:hami = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ytm_oasis_garrison months = 180 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}
